alert.name: ECSServiceAlarm
alert.summary: CloudWatch alarm fired for ECS service checkout

logs: EVENT BackOff Pod/checkout-c6c48965c-w5f9f: Back-off restarting failed container checkout in pod checkout-c6c48965c-w5f9f_warden-pg(<UUID_1>)
EVENT BackOff Pod/checkout-c6c48965c-sgdt9: Back-off restarting failed container checkout in pod checkout-c6c48965c-sgdt9_warden-pg(<UUID_2>)

root_cause.hypothesis: Deploy revision 8 (image bump python:3.12-alpine -> python:3.12.7-alpine) triggered checkout container crash loop. New image causes 'fatal: configuration invalid' on startup, pods never ready, repeated BackOff restarts.
evidence: Deploy at 13:22:55Z, crash logs start 13:24:24Z — tight time correlation
pods_ready=0/2, restart_count=8, both pods in BackOff
Both pods log identical fatal: configuration invalid at startup (app-level fail, not infra)
oom_killed=0, crashloop_containers flag=0 despite active backoff — points to app config parse fail, not resource kill
ruled_out: OOM kill (oom_killed_containers=0, though memory_limit_mib=48 is suspiciously low — can't fully rule out mem-constrained failure w/o more logs)
Node/infra failure (pods scheduled fine, only container startup fails)

proposal.reasoning: Revision 8 bumped image python:3.12-alpine -> python:3.12.7-alpine at 13:22:55Z. Both pods immediately crash loop with 'fatal: configuration invalid', 0/2 ready, 8 restarts, BackOff. No other deploys, no OOM/memory signal. New image config incompatibility is direct cause.
proposal.expected_effect: Revert checkout deployment to prior working image (3.12-alpine), pods restart on old image, config valid, pods_ready returns to 2/2, restarts stop.

reasons: Passed all policies. Held for operator approval before execution.
